FN-G3Z7M62-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 189
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator April Weaver
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 01/26/2026
Senate Bill 189 as introduced could decrease the obligations of the Department of Corrections
by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of any decrease in license plate
production costs due to the provisions of this bill.
